title: lanes (World, the fight lanes: docs/world/fight-lanes-world.md)
description: data/biomes/lanes.json: the fight lanes of the re-laid city, in fighter heights (bh = 75 units), z positive toward the camera. The band is z_front to z_back; the lanes of kind block carry the footprints (rows 1 and 2), the scenery lanes rows 0 and 3, a street has row -1 and holds none; the strips split a street into sidewalk, kerb and carriageway. Ordering and containment are checked by tools/lib/xref-lanes.js (lanes-name, lanes-order, lanes-overlap, lanes-row, lanes-band, strip-lane, strip-order, strip-inside, strip-overlap). Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore.

z_front.description: The front of the band (above z_back: lanes-order).

d_min_bh.description: The least depth, in fighter heights, a footprint may have.

kind.description: street (no footprints, row -1), block (rows 1 and 2), scenery or ridge (rows 0 and 3).

top.description: The lane's front edge (above bottom: lanes-order).

row.description: -1 for a street, else the row of footprints the lane holds (lanes-row).

lanes.description: The lanes, front to back (they may not overlap: lanes-overlap).

lane.description: The street lane this strip is in (strip-lane).

top.description: The strip's front edge (above bottom, inside its lane: strip-order, strip-inside).

strips.description: The strips of the streets (the strips of one lane do not overlap: strip-overlap).

demo_start.description: Where a demo start (a setup's "start": "crossing") puts the pair: the crossing of the street lane named by `lane` nearest the middle of the first district whose look is `look` (settlements.json looks). Optional; the demo starts at START_X when it is absent.
